hooks.name: Property suite guard
hooks.description: The calc engine is the product. Any engine edit must keep the property suite green.

action.prompt: A file under lib/calc was just saved. Run `npx vitest run lib/calc mcp` and report the result. If a property test fails, the engine is wrong: fix lib/calc, never weaken the property or the counterexample. If you changed a constant, say which constant and why, and confirm it matches .kiro/steering/units-and-conventions.md. Do not add example-based tests to paper over a failing property.
